mines.mine_notes: Gold-copper project, Yentna Mining District, Alaska (377 state mining claims). Held through publicly traded subsidiary U.S. GoldMining Inc., in which GoldMining owns ~74.2%. 2024 updated MRE (Sue Bird, P.Eng.; eff. Sept 12, 2024; S-K 1300): Indicated 294.474 Mt @ 0.42 g/t Au, 0.16% Cu, 2.01 g/t Ag (0.68 g/t AuEq) = 6,482 koz AuEq in situ (3,933 koz Au, 1,024 Mlb Cu, 18,987 koz Ag); Inferred 198.241 Mt (157.809 Mt open pit @ 0.57 g/t AuEq + 40.432 Mt Raintree underground). Open pit constrained at NSR cut-off US$10/t; Raintree UG at US$25/t. Initial assessment/PEA commenced during FY2025 (under way at FY-end). FY2025 Whistler spend $4.1M (U.S. GoldMining).

Pará State, Brazil; 46,000 ha, 100% owned. Updated MRE (Reno Pressacco; eff. Jan 28, 2025): Indicated 19.418 Mt @ 1.00 g/t Au = 624 koz; Inferred 5.557 Mt @ 0.72 g/t Au = 129 koz; break-even cut-off 0.27 g/t Au within base-case pit shell, @ US$1,950/oz Au. Largest exploration program to date in FY2025 (9,533 m drilling: diamond, RC, auger; FY2025 spend $2.6M); new prospects incl. William South. FY2025 MRE effective date falls within fiscal 2025 (reported Feb 26, 2025).

Antioquia, Colombia (porphyry gold-copper). PEA announced Sept 7, 2023 (NI 43-101 tech report eff. Jul 24, 2023): 1.29 Moz AuEq over 11.2-yr LOM (incl. 203.9 Mlb Cu, 2.98 Moz Ag); open pit, strip ratio 5.5:1, 15,000 tpd; pre-tax NPV5% US$447.3M / after-tax NPV5% US$279.5M, after-tax IRR 15.2% @ US$1,750/oz Au, US$21/oz Ag, US$3.50/lb Cu; after-tax cash cost US$795/AuEq oz; AISC US$912/AuEq oz (net of by-product credits). FY2025 spend C$0.2M.

notes: FY ended November 30, 2025 (fiscal_year 2025); MD&A dated Feb 25, 2026; figures CAD. Resource-stage company — no production, no reserves, no revenue. FY2025 net loss C$15.3M ($0.07/share; incl. non-controlling interest) vs C$27.3M in FY2024. FY2025 exploration expenditures C$8.6M (Whistler C$4.1M via U.S. GoldMining; São Jorge C$2.6M). Other exploration-stage projects (no economic study at FY-end): Titiribi and Yarumalito (Colombia), Crucero (Peru), Yellowknife (Canada), Cachoeira (Brazil), Rea (Canada). Almaden/Nutmeg Mountain sold to NevGold subsidiary (Jan 2024); equity-method NevGold investment ended Aug 25, 2025. Head office: Suite 1830, 1188 West Georgia Street, Vancouver BC. Global aggregated M&I+I resource statement across all projects is presented in the FY2025 AIF (Whistler, São Jorge and La Mina figures extracted above).
